[00:00:00] Rui Almeida: Good morning. This is the BX-17 blister line huddle for Tuesday.
[00:00:04] Dr. Grace Mensah: The sealer temperature drifted again overnight. It reached 190 degrees before the alarm went off.
[00:00:11] Tomas Berg: Maintenance replaced the thermocouple at 6 this morning. It has held at 180 degrees since.
[00:00:18] Rui Almeida: Did any blisters from the night shift fail the seal check?
[00:00:22] Dr. Grace Mensah: 2 trays failed. They are in quarantine, and I have opened a deviation.
[00:00:28] Rui Almeida: Then here is the decision: the line restarts at 10:00, with a seal check every 30 minutes for the rest of the week.
[00:00:34] Tomas Berg: I will log every reading in the batch record and send the summary to quality by Thursday.
[00:00:40] Dr. Grace Mensah: And I will close the deviation once the root cause report is in, by Friday.
[00:00:45] Rui Almeida: Thank you both. That is everything for today.
